t: Vanessa Low: Paralympic Runner Reunited With Missing Prosthetic Legs
s: May 17, 2016 - “It was a lot of long, hard work to be able to achieve that and to be able buy those legs, and they’re, like, a big part of me, they’re my mobility, they’re my job,” Low, 25, told KPHO. “Even if I get new legs, it would take $30,000 and three, four weeks to replace them,” she continued. Three to four weeks without practice would completely derail the young runner’s training for the Paralympics. So, she took to social media asking for help finding or replacing the missing blades.
